title: Derivative-Informed Training of Neural Operators On-the-Fly via Sketched Tangent Consistency
abstract: arXiv:2609.32797v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Derivative-informed training improves neural operators by directly supervising their input-output sensitivities, which is crucial when neural operators are used as differentiable surrogates for inverse problems, PDE-constrained optimization, design, and control. However, existing methods rely on offline-generated derivative labels, making data generation slow, storage-intensive, and difficult to adapt across datasets, resolutions, or perturbation bases. We propose sketched tangent consistency loss (sTCL), an on-the-fly derivative-informed training objective that, for PDEs with a known and differentiable residual, enforces sensitivity consistency directly from the governing equation without offline tangent labels or neural-operator architecture changes. sTCL uses randomly sketched input perturbations to provide a lightweight derivative-level physics constraint during training. translated_title: 基于草图化切向一致性的神经算子即时导数信息训练
translated_abstract: 导数信息训练通过直接监督神经算子的输入-输出敏感性来改进其性能，这在将神经算子用作逆问题、偏微分方程约束优化、设计和控制的可微代理模型时至关重要。然而，现有方法依赖于离线生成的导数标签，这导致数据生成缓慢、存储开销大，且难以在不同数据集、分辨率或扰动基之间迁移适配。我们提出了草图化切向一致性损失，这是一种即时（on-the-fly）的导数信息训练目标：对于具有已知且可微残差的偏微分方程，它直接从控制方程出发强制执行敏感性一致性，无需离线切向标签，也无需改变神经算子的网络架构。sTCL 利用随机草图的输入扰动，在训练过程中提供轻量级的导数层面物理约束。然而，原始的前向敏感性残差惩罚可能会（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出草图化切向一致性损失，这是一种无需离线导数标签、在训练中直接利用PDE控制方程通过随机草图扰动即时强制执行敏感性一致性的轻量级导数信息训练方法。
en_tdlr: We propose the sketched tangent consistency loss (sTCL), an on-the-fly derivative-informed training objective that uses randomly sketched input perturbations to enforce sensitivity consistency directly from the governing PDE, eliminating the need for offline derivative labels or architecture changes.
